fee_notes: First traditional location: $25,000 (reduced to $20,000 for Eligible Military/501(c)(3)). Second traditional location: $20,000 (reduced to $16,000 for Eligible Military/501(c)(3)). Third and each subsequent traditional location: $15,000 (reduced to $12,000 for Eligible Military/501(c)(3)). First and each subsequent non-traditional location: $20,000 (reduced to $16,000 for Eligible Military/501(c)(3)). No refunds under any circumstances. Fee is waived for transfers or renewals. Franchisor may periodically reduce the fee for limited-time promotions.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") for your first traditional Planet Smoothie restaurant is $25,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is reduced for your second traditional restaurant is reduced to $20,000. The Initial Franchise Fee for your third and each subsequent restaurant is reduced to $15,000. The Initial Franchise Fee for your first and each subsequent non-traditional Planet Smoothie restaurant location is $20,000.
